recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-19530 core clarification without duplicating detailed SDC examples or moving unrelated SDC-only expression guidance into core.
issue_request: FHIR-19530 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR core and asked that variables created by the Questionnaire variable and questionnaire-context mechanisms document how they are referenced from FHIRPath, including normal percent-prefixed variable syntax and error handling for name collisions in the same scope.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly tagged FHIR-19530 was found. The Jira comment points to HL7/sdc commit c5e291ea2f56ad3da045851133a789f4289791ab, which applied the requested percent-prefixed access and collision-error wording to the SDC expressions page. Later core issue FHIR-33539 added SDC-derived QuestionnaireResponse FHIRPath guidance to core, including percent-prefixed access, but omitted the collision-error rule.
additional_context: The active core FHIRPath page is in build scope through publish.ini and links readers to QuestionnaireResponse for resource-specific FHIRPath variable guidance. QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Current guidance represents the historical questionnaire-context behavior through SDC launchContext naming, and SDC guidance plus the FHIR-33539 Zulip thread describe these names as variables injected into FHIRPath evaluation.
reconciliation: Edited source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml so the FHIRPath Additions section now states that same context names defined within the same containing element are an error, while descendant items can define the same name for their own scope.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml: added the missing collision-error rule to the existing percent-prefixed named-expression guidance.
